Sri Panwa Lagoon

Villa in Bang Tao
HomeSaleSri Panwa Lagoon

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

Lakefront residences within a 60-rai mixed-use development in Bang Tao, comprising 16 pool villas and 12 Multi-Flex houses delivered as customisable shells. Architecture is by Habita Architects with interiors by Studio Chemistri, and the project is limited to 28 homes.

Sri Panwa Lagoon: key facts

  • Sri Panwa Lagoon is a pool villa and multi-flex house in Bang Tao, Phuket, developed by Charn Issara.
  • Units: 3–6 bedrooms, 307–857 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Leasehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿39,800,000.
  • Nearest beach: Bang Tao Beach (2.4 km, straight line).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Greenhouse Kindergarten Phuket (1.3 km); HEI Schools Phuket (4.1 km); Wattanapat Phuket Hospital (4.6 km); HeadStart International School (City Campus) (11.4 km).

  • 24/7 security
